title: Genuine hospital call
blurb: Apollo confirms an appointment, asks her to bring reports, and says payment happens at the counter after the visit.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning, this is Kavya from Dr. Mehta's clinic at Apollo, Jubilee Hills. Am I speaking with Mrs. Lakshmi Iyer?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm calling to confirm your follow-up appointment with Dr. Mehta tomorrow, Thursday, at 4:30 PM. Does that still work for you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, 4:30 is fine. Do I need to bring anything?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please bring your previous prescription and the blood-test report from last week. If the lab has emailed it to you, a printout or the PDF on your phone is fine.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright. Is there any payment to be made in advance?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, ma'am, nothing in advance. Consultation is paid at the reception counter after the visit, and you'll get a printed receipt.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Basement parking, level 2, and the OPD is on the third floor. If you're running late, just call the clinic landline — the number on your appointment card.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One more thing — the doctor mentioned a scan. Will that be tomorrow?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dr. Mehta will decide after the consultation. If a scan is needed, we'll schedule it and you can pay at the radiology counter directly.
